Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing a pilot program for the settlement of water rights.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to participation by the state of Washington in apilot negotiation and settlement of water rights involving WashingtonIndian tribes and the federal government; adding a new chapter to Title43 RCW; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that state water lawmust take into account rights to water based in both state and federallaw. The legislature also finds that it is in the interest of thepeople of the state, the nation, and Indian tribes located within thestate to achieve greater certainty and security regarding therespective water rights based on state and federal law. Thelegislature therefore intends for the state to participate in afederally authorized pilot negotiation and settlement process withtribal governments and the United States regarding their respectivewater rights.

(1) The legislature intends for the state ofWashington to proceed under the provisions of this chapter to p. 1 HB 2407participate in a federally sanctioned and facilitated pilot process todetermine and quantify water rights claimed by Indian tribes and theUnited States. (2) The state shall establish a negotiating team within the officeof the governor to participate in this pilot program. (3) The federal pilot negotiation process includes a scopingprocess, development of alternatives, timelines, decisionmakingprocess, funding alternatives, and mediation.

The sum of two hundred thousand dollars, oras much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated from the generalfund for the fiscal year ending July 1, 2005, to the governor's officeto defray the costs of forming and operating the negotiating teamestablished in section 2(2) of this act and to pay an equitable shareof the costs of facilitation by the United States Institute.
Sections 1 and 2 of this act constitute anew chapter in Title 43 RCW.
